media.title: Berlin Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper's Berlin years. Includes verified German press items from Deutsches Zeitungsportal, film announcements, reviews, broadcast schedules, advertisements, Berlin contextual documents, and related press items from 1929-1933. SRC0023 is represented here as a ZLB Digital Collections / Berliner Adreßbuch 1932 address-directory entry for Kaper.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s Berlin years, combining documents, press items and film-periodical sources.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual sources relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Berlin years, including directory evidence and German film-periodical materials.
